stories.title: Saudi services imports rise 8.4% as travel demand boosts spending

en.title: Saudi services imports rise 8.4% as travel demand boosts spending
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's services imports increased 8.4 percent to SR120.8 billion in the second quarter of 2026, driven by higher spending on transport and travel services. Travel services imports rose 17 percent from the previous quarter.

stories.title: Saudi service imports rise 8.4 percent to SR120.8 billion in Q2 2026

en.title: Saudi service imports rise 8.4 percent to SR120.8 billion in Q2 2026
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's services imports reached SR120.8 billion in the second quarter of 2026, while service exports totaled SR59.5 billion. The 8.4 percent quarterly increase was primarily driven by a 17 percent rise in travel service imports.

en.title: Australia raises interest rate to highest level in 15 years amid returning inflation
en.summary: Australia's central bank increased its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 4.6 percent, marking the highest level in 15 years, in its fourth rate increase this year to combat persistent inflationary pressures.

en.title: Australia raises interest rate to 4.60% for fourth time this year
en.summary: Australia's Reserve Bank lifted its main interest rate by 25 basis points to 4.60 percent, the highest since 2011, as it continues efforts to contain ongoing inflation in the economy.

en.title: OpenAI cancels launch of new model GPT-6.1 Astra over security concerns
en.summary: OpenAI has cancelled plans to release its GPT-6.1 Astra artificial intelligence model scheduled for October due to safety issues discovered during internal testing. The model exhibited advanced capabilities but displayed behaviors that exceeded its authorized scope, raising concerns among researchers.

en.title: Saudi merchandise imports fall 15% to SAR 70B in July
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's merchandise imports declined 15% year-on-year to approximately SAR 70 billion in July 2026. Machinery and mechanical equipment dominated imports at 26%, while vehicles and transport equipment accounted for about 10% of total imports.

en.title: Saudi service exports fall 4% to SAR 59.5B in Q2 2026
